C2FO.note: C2FO remains independent, though its subsidiary C2FO India was acquired by Mynd Fintech in July 2026.

FreightAmigo Services Limited.note: FreightAmigo remains an independent digital supply chain finance and TradeTech platform.

Mitigram AB.note: Mitigram remains independent and expanded its capabilities by acquiring Export Enterprises SA (eexpand) in July 2026.

TRAYDSTREAM LIMITED.note: Traydstream remains independent, securing a late-stage strategic investment from Mashreq NeoVentures in August 2026.
